A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''businessman''' was a prominent interplanetary shipping magnate during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but because he had started his businesses with a loan from the [[Exchange]], the criminal syndicate expected the magnate to give them a large cut of his extensive fortune.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Return on Investment}}</ref>
